scripts.dev: npm run build -w @comparison/contracts && npm run build -w @comparison/web && npm run db:generate && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @comparison/fastify-api" "npm run dev -w @comparison/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @comparison/contracts && npm run build -w @comparison/web && npm run build -w @comparison/fastify-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @comparison/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @comparison/web && npm run typecheck -w @comparison/fastify-api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
